newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Kuoni plans 30-35 percent dividend ratio.
newsitem.headline: Kuoni plans 30-35 percent dividend ratio.

text.p: Swiss travel and tourism group Kuoni Reisen AG plans to pay out a dividend of 30 to 35 percent of its profit, chief financial officer Max Katz said.
"We are moving in a framework of 30 to 35 percent," he said after giving a presentation to financial analysts.
Last year Kuoni doubled its dividend to 35 Swiss francs and paid an additional 10-franc bonus for a total payout ratio of 32 percent.
Katz said his earlier statement that operating profit should rise more strongly than sales in 1996 and 1997 applied to net profit as well.
